name: #148 ESAI
description:
ESAI is an AI-powered college advising platform that pitched on The Pitch Season 12 and received $125,000 from three investors at a $5M valuation. Founder Julia Dixon then appeared on Shark Tank Season 16, where Mark Cuban initially offered a valuation half of what The Pitch investors had already agreed to pay.

On The Pitch, Julia faced investors Cyan Banister, Charles Hudson (Precursor Ventures), Elizabeth Yin (Hustle Fund), Mac Conwell, and Jesse Middleton (Flybridge). Her pitch made the case that college advising is broken for the students who need it most, and that AI can close the gap.

Key details:
- Company: ESAI (AI-powered college advising)
- Outcome: Funded — $125K at $5M valuation (standard SAFE)
- Investors: Cyan Banister, Charles Hudson (Precursor Ventures), Elizabeth Yin (Hustle Fund)
- Season 12, Episode 10

After The Pitch, Julia took ESAI to Shark Tank Season 16. Mark Cuban's opening offer: $250K for 10% — implying a $2.5M valuation, half what three VCs had already paid at $5M. The Pitch investors valued ESAI at twice what Shark Tank's most prominent shark initially offered. Watch the pitch that started it all.
